name: kicom-expansion-living-cell/3
perception_action_loop: observe -> remember -> derive capabilities/boundaries -> act -> observe result -> update perception/action/world memory
peer_evidence_policy: neighbor knowledge beyond lineage requires verified signed federation evidence; arbitrary remote probing remains forbidden
birth_policy: all intrinsic subsystems and the situational world model are materialized and verified before node initialization commits
evolution_policy: candidate creation and deterministic static fitness remain available; executable autonomous promotion is explicitly deferred by current project priority
reproduction_policy: autonomous reproduction is explicitly deferred by current project priority
external_boundary_policy: human authorization only when a protected external system, credential or permission requires it
inheritance_policy: architecture may be inherited; identity, secrets, mutable state and project memory are local
